reason: Thirty-five hundred bucks is two months of what I would pay a bookkeeper, and I cannot see the number he would save me until after I have already given him an hour I do not have. Free look sounds like a sales call, and I do those from the truck or not at all.
objection: He quotes his fee before he has seen my books, so $1,500 to $3,500 is a guess I am the one holding. I need to know what the fix is and what it saves me per month in actual dollars before I sign anything.
would_change_my_mind: A flat number in writing up front and one of my own vendors or landlords telling me it paid for itself in the first 60 days.
